core_obligations: Reduce the situation: one may replace X by an open neighbourhood of x and S by an elementary etale neighbourhood of s, so by openness of flatness the module may be assumed flat over S, and one may assume X and S affine and, after shrinking X further, that every point of the associated primes of the fibre over s is a generalization of x; this property survives elementary etale neighbourhoods, so the flat along the fibre lemma applies and gives an affine diagram with g etale, X_s inside g(X') and the global sections of g^*F projective over the ring of S (proof lines 5673-5696).

Claim purity of the restriction to an affine open U of g(X') containing x: purity of F|_U along U_s means that after any elementary etale neighbourhood of s every point xi of the relative associated primes of F|_U over a point specializing to s specializes into U_s; since U lies in g(X') one can lift xi to xi' in X', purity of the pulled back module gives a specialization xi' to a point x' of the associated primes of the fibre of g^*F, that point pushes down to an associated point of the fibre of F by the etale lemma on fibres, and by the choice of X this pushed down point specializes to x in U, so xi specializes into U_s (proof lines 5698-5720).

Conclude: once F|_U is pure along the fibre, purity relative to S follows after shrinking S by the purity openness lemma, and then projectivity of the global sections follows from the criterion that a flat finitely presented module which is pure relative to the base has projective global sections (proof lines 5700-5705).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the affine case with the module flat over the base and the associated points of the fibre generalizing x (proof lines 5673-5696).
Prove purity of the restriction to an affine open inside the image of the etale morphism by lifting associated points and pushing forward specializations (proof lines 5698-5720).
Upgrade purity relative to the base to projectivity of the global sections and shrink S accordingly (proof lines 5700-5705).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a module of finite presentation flat at a point over a locally finitely presented base, an affine elementary etale neighbourhood and an affine open containing the lifted point such that the global sections of the restriction are projective over the ring of the neighbourhood (statement lines 5661-5671, tag 05ME). The proof is a real reduction: it makes the module flat over the base by openness of flatness, arranges that the associated points of the special fibre are generalizations of the point by shrinking, uses the flat along the fibre lemma to get an etale neighbourhood with projective global sections, and then proves purity of the restriction on an affine open inside the image by lifting an associated point along the etale morphism and pushing a specialization forward. That lifting argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
